title: ESCALATED - /menu keeps sliding: position 5.5 -> 6.6 (-1.1, second straight period) and -125 clicks on FLAT impressions; Whitefish Bay and Monona menu queries stuck at pos ~4.3
detail: Flagged last run at 5.3 -> 6.2; it got worse, not better. /menu is now at position 6.6 against 5.5 in the prior window - a 1.1-point drop, the largest of any significant page - while impressions were essentially flat (+357) and clicks fell 2,986 -> 2,861. Flat impressions with worse position and fewer clicks is a ranking loss, not demand; there is no demand explanation available for this one. The per-city menu queries confirm it is not isolated: 'forage kitchen whitefish bay menu' sits at 4.4 (was 1.8) and 'forage kitchen monona menu' at 4.3 (was 1.9), both roughly where they were last week, so neither has recovered. 'forage menu' also slipped 3.7 -> 4.6. IMPORTANT CONTRAST that narrows the diagnosis: 'forage kitchen pewaukee menu' IMPROVED to 1.6 (from 2.9) and 'forage kitchen brookfield menu' held at 1.9. So the mechanism is not site-wide - two cities lost the menu slot and two kept it. Action: pull up 'forage kitchen whitefish bay menu' and 'forage kitchen monona menu' side by side with the Pewaukee and Brookfield equivalents and diff what ranks. Specifically compare (1) whether the Whitefish Bay and Monona location pages link to the menu with city-qualified anchor text the way Pewaukee/Brookfield do, (2) whether their LocalBusiness schema carries a hasMenu property pointing at the menu URL, and (3) whether a third-party listing (DoorDash/Toast/Yelp) has taken the slot in just those two markets. This is the highest-confidence fixable item on the list - the working examples are in your own site.

title: RE-ESCALATED - Whitefish Bay drifting again after being marked resolved: all four signals worse (page 2.9 -> 3.3, 'forage kitchen whitefish bay' 1.4 -> 2.8, 'forage whitefish bay' 1.3 -> 2.1, menu query 1.8 -> 4.4)
detail: I called this resolved two runs ago; that call no longer holds and I am re-opening it. Whitefish Bay is the one market where every signal moved the wrong way at once with nothing compensating: the page slipped 2.9 -> 3.3, the primary branded query fell off #1 (1.4 -> 2.8, -18 clicks), the shorter variant also softened (1.3 -> 2.1, though it still gained +83 clicks on demand), and the menu query is at 4.4. This matters because elsewhere in the account, position moves are mostly a VARIANT RESHUFFLE - when one city's query loses rank a sibling gains it (Hilldale: 'forage kitchen hilldale' 1.0 -> 1.3 losing 58 clicks while 'forage hilldale' went 3.8 -> 1.3 gaining 33; Brookfield: 'forage brookfield' collapsed 1.1 -> 4.7 while 'forage kitchen brookfield' took #1 with +212 clicks). Whitefish Bay has no such compensating winner, which is what separates it from the noise. The page is still the highest-click location (627) so the absolute damage is small so far - this is about stopping the drift early. Action: check the Whitefish Bay Google Business Profile against Brookfield's (the market that is winning) - verification status, primary category, hours, photo recency, review velocity. Then confirm the location page has not lost internal links or had its title/H1 changed. Re-check next run: if the primary query is still off #1, treat it as a page-authority problem and add homepage/menu internal links.

title: Sun Prairie position decaying a third straight period (2.2 -> 2.6 -> 2.9) with impressions -2,909 on top of last period's -2,443
detail: Third consecutive flag and the only location page with a sustained, monotonic position decline. Clicks fell 431 -> 374 (-13%, just under the -15% threshold but down again), and impressions dropped another 2,909 after losing 2,443 the period before - roughly 5,400 impressions shed across two periods, the largest sustained visibility loss of any location page. The page position has now degraded three periods running: 2.2 -> 2.6 -> 2.9. PARTIAL COUNTER-EVIDENCE worth weighing: the branded query 'forage sun prairie' actually IMPROVED to position 1.2 (from 2.1) while still losing 28 clicks, which is a clean demand signal - people searching Sun Prairie by name find it fine, there are just fewer of them. So the branded intent is healthy and the loss is concentrated in broader discovery queries feeding the page. That fits the impression collapse better than a rankings catastrophe. Action: (1) Confirm the Sun Prairie Google Business Profile has no lingering summer-hours edit, temporary-closure flag, or stale photos - this check was recommended last run and should be closed out now. (2) Compare its GBP completeness against Middleton, which went the other way this period (+54 clicks, position improving 6.3 -> 6.0). (3) Verify the page carries full LocalBusiness schema with geo coordinates. If position crosses 3.5 next run while impressions fall again, escalate to a crawl/index inspection.

title: RE-OPENED - /faq lost 2.2 positions (5.0 -> 7.2) and 'forage kitchen nutrition' fell 1.1 -> 2.8, both masked by rising clicks
detail: I marked this resolved last run because it left the loser table. That was the wrong read - it left the loser table on CLICKS (+67, 273 -> 340) while its position deteriorated sharply, 5.0 -> 7.2, the biggest position drop of any page on the site this period. The same pattern shows in its main query: 'forage kitchen nutrition' gained 49 clicks but fell from position 1.1 to 2.8. Rising demand is papering over a real rank loss on both, exactly the failure mode worth catching early - when demand normalizes, position 7.2 does not hold 340 clicks. The FAQ page captures allergen, gluten-free, nutrition and catering questions, which are high-intent and cheap to defend. Action: verify the page still carries valid FAQPage structured data (run it through the Rich Results Test - a schema break would explain a 2-point drop cleanly and is the most likely single cause); confirm no recent title/H1 or content edit removed the question-and-answer markup or reordered the high-intent Q&As out of the top; and make sure it is internally linked from /menu and the homepage. Restoring position ~5 protects roughly 90-100 clicks/28d that are currently riding on demand rather than rank.

title: Near-me / LocalBusiness schema audit STILL OPEN (5th week) - now with three 'restaurants <city>' discovery queries lost outright
detail: Carried forward unchanged for a fifth run because the audit still has not been done, and the cost of not doing it is now visible in the lost-query list rather than just the trend lines. Three local-discovery queries dropped to zero clicks this period: 'restaurants brookfield' (was pos 13.1, 228 impressions), 'restaurants middleton wi' (was 22.4), and 'restaurants champaign il' (was 44.3) - plus 'salad restaurants near me' (was 8.8). These are exactly the generic proximity queries that complete LocalBusiness markup and a well-maintained Google Business Profile are supposed to defend, and they are the discovery layer above your branded traffic. Meanwhile 'healthy food near me' slipped to position 7.7 (from 7.1) and lost 15 clicks. The audit itself is mechanical and unchanged from prior weeks: confirm EVERY /locations/* page carries name, full postal address, geo latitude/longitude, openingHoursSpecification, telephone, servesCuisine, and hasMenu, plus an embedded Google map. Validate two pages in the Rich Results Test - Brookfield (winning) against Sun Prairie or Whitefish Bay (drifting) - and port whatever the winner has. This single audit closes a piece of the /menu, Whitefish Bay, and Sun Prairie items above, which is why it keeps reappearing; doing it once retires four flags.

title: Top line is healthy - clicks +636 (23,825), CTR 2.97% -> 3.49%; and Champaign DE-ESCALATED after its page position recovered 7.2 -> 6.4 with clicks +53%
detail: Context so the position numbers above are not over-read. Clicks rose to 23,825 (+636), CTR improved again to 3.49% from 2.97%, and non-branded clicks edged up to 1,854 (+68). Impressions fell 781k -> 682k (-12.6%), still concentrated in informational blog posts (kombucha-health-benefits -9,021, healthy-lunch-ideas -27,352) whose positions are flat or improving - the same AI-overview absorption as the last three weeks. Do not chase it. Site average position worsened 8.6 -> 9.0, which is mix effect from shedding low-ranking informational impressions, not broad decline. CHAMPAIGN DE-ESCALATED from high: after four periods of drift I escalated it last run and recommended a crawl check - the page has now recovered, position 7.2 -> 6.4 and clicks 238 -> 365 (+53%, the biggest location gain on the site). The branded query 'forage kitchen champaign' is still off #1 at 2.8 (was 1.7), so keep the Google Business Profile hours/photos/category check on the list for the fall semester, but the crawl/index escalation is no longer warranted. OTHER WINS: Brookfield holds #1 on its primary query with +212 clicks; Milwaukee Public Market +80 clicks with position improving to 5.1; Middleton +54 with position improving to 6.0; 'forge kitchen menu' (the common misspelling) jumped 5.1 -> 1.8. STANDING GAP, fifth week: /locations/state-street-madison-wi is improving slowly (66 clicks, +15, impressions +752) but its CTR is still ~0.9% against 3-4% for peer pages at a similar position (4.3) - that gap is a title/meta-description problem, not a ranking one. Rewrite the title and description to lead with 'State Street' and 'UW campus' and add a homepage link.
